title: Complete origin and CSRF negative tests
description: Complete negative coverage for Origin/Host/proxy handling and CSRF protection on all protected mutating/sensitive routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Absent, malformed, cross-site, and allowed Origin cases are tested without trusting forged forwarded headers by default
Protected mutating/sensitive routes reject missing/invalid CSRF/session context and do not mutate data
`XT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` parsing is strict, bounded, and cannot be used to inject arbitrary origins
Tests cover login/refresh exceptions, proxy trust flag, custom port, HTTPS, and XUI/tool exceptions

steps.details: Add route-level cases for each protected route family and each origin/proxy state before production changes.

steps.description: Read `src/lib/api.ts`, auth/session helpers, proxy.ts, route handlers, and existing origin tests; map the actual gate order.

steps.details: Fix only demonstrated gaps, preserving the documented public health/login/refresh exceptions and XUI scope.

steps.description: Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and inspect diffs for secret/logging regressions.

technicalNotes: Origin absence may be allowed for non-browser clients; test the actual intended policy rather than assuming every absent header is hostile.
